Class OffscreenGroovyPlugin.Windows

java.lang.Object
com.cleanroommc.groovyscript.registry.NamedRegistry
com.cleanroommc.groovyscript.registry.VirtualizedRegistry<Object>
com.sbancuz.offscreen.compat.groovy.OffscreenGroovyPlugin.Windows
All Implemented Interfaces:
com.cleanroommc.groovyscript.api.INamed, com.cleanroommc.groovyscript.api.IScriptReloadable
Enclosing class:
OffscreenGroovyPlugin
public static final class OffscreenGroovyPlugin.Windows extends com.cleanroommc.groovyscript.registry.VirtualizedRegistry<Object>
Client-only script operations with reload ownership above the full Java API.

Returned builders are the actual OffscreenButtons.Builder, so closures can use every shared visual option and build vanilla or ModularUI controls. The default action tracks its opened window. Replacing that action with arbitrary Java API calls transfers resource ownership back to the script author.

Reload invalidates old callbacks immediately, then schedules closure of this registry's windows and removal of its attached actions on the client thread. It never closes unrelated addon windows. Native cleanup can therefore complete after the reload hook returns. The facade does not run GUI work on a dedicated server or worker thread.

    • onReload

      public void onReload()
      Invalidates callbacks immediately and arranges main-thread disposal of only this owner's resources. Dedicated servers have no native resources, so this hook performs only common Java bookkeeping there.
